## Publication standard

::: {.publication-standard}
::: {}
### Inspectable

Material claims identify their evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and break conditions.
:::

::: {}
### Revisioned

Every public release states its status and revision; corrections replace the controlling version without erasing provenance.
:::

::: {}
### Human-gated

AI may assist research and drafting, but consequential decisions remain attributable to accountable people.
:::
:::

Each release is labeled by status and revision. The purpose is to make claims inspectable, preserve credible disagreement, and expose ideas to correction—not to present unfinished concepts as established science or deployable products.
